items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: Who is that Glenn Miller? ... Well I wouldn’t say that because he had that clarinet lead. But the thing is that he was smart...

ctx.x: The whole band, the Glenn Miller band is over. So nobody dared like even —

Right. There was some peer pressure there. Yeah, wow, I’ve heard of some stories but I never heard that kind of story. Do you think you play differently if you’re under the influence than if you’re not?
